jobs.title: Summer Analyst - Energy and Real Assets - Structured Finance, Transportation at Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
jobs.description: Employer: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank Expires: 11/20/2026 ABOUT CRÉDIT AGRICOLE CIBCrédit Agricole CIB is the Corporate and Investment Banking arm of the Crédit Agricole Group, the 10th largest banking group worldwide by balance sheet size (The Banker, 2025). The Bank offers clients a broad range of products and services across capital markets, investment banking, structured finance, and corporate banking.As the No. 1 retail bank in France, Crédit Agricole is the leading financial partner of the French economy and one of the largest retail banks in Europe — committed to building a world-class European leader in banking and insurance in accordance with the UN Global Compact. Summer Analyst Internship Program SummaryThe Summer Analyst Internship Program offers students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in investment banking within a high-profile department at Crédit Agricole CIB. Interns work alongside Associates, Vice Presidents, and senior bankers, receiving mentorship and real-world exposure to deal structuring, financial analysis, and portfolio management. Top performers have the opportunity to convert into full-time US Analyst roles following graduation.Divisional OverviewCrédit Agricole CIB is a worldwide leader in aircraft and rail financing, with numerous industry awards over the past 15 years. The Transportation Group within the Energy and Real Assets Division specializes in originating Capital Market solutions and creating tailor-made financing solutions for airlines, lessors, and rail companies across North and Latin America. The Intern will join a dynamic, collaborative team and contribute to a market-leading practice with an established reputation for excellence in structured finance solutions across the Americas region. RESPONSIBILITIES Transaction Origination & Execution: Support Associates, Vice Presidents, and Relationship Managers in structuring, originating, and executing sophisticated financing transactions. Gain full knowledge of the bank's systems and procedures. Run initial profitability and collateral/debt sizing analyses on new deals and assess counterparties' ratings. Financial Analysis: Support Associates in preparing credit analyses on airlines, aircraft leasing companies, and railcar leasing companies for new transactions and annual reviews. Client Materials: Support Associates, Vice Presidents, and Relationship Managers in creating compelling pitch books and client presentations to support business development. Portfolio Management: Under the supervision of the Portfolio Manager, support Associates with conducting annual reviews of existing transactions and counterparty ratings. Monitor compliance, KYC requirements, covenants, and special projects. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with credit department, back/middle office, and product groups (Loan Syndications, Interest Rate Derivatives, Securitization, Debt Capital Markets, etc.) to liaise and respond to credit questions and coordinate on transactions. Cross-Business Support: On a regular basis and depending on workload, provide support to other Energy and Real Assets Business Lines, particularly those dealing with mobile assets (Shipping and Intermodal). MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Currently enrolled student or recent graduate expected to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028 Bachelor's degree in Finance or related field Must be eligible to work in the US without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future (including but not limited to F-1, OPT, CPT, H-1B, or any other visa category) 0–1 years of professional experience in Finance or a related fieldPREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Relevant business/finance coursework in school Previous internship experience in banking or structured finance Proactive disposition with strong interpersonal skills and problem-solving mindset Strong analytical, credit, and communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) Fluency in English; Spanish is a plus Familiarity with transportation, aviation, or rail sectors

jobs.title: 10:12 Sports Summer Internship at 1012 Sports
jobs.description: Employer: 1012 Sports Expires: 11/20/2026 10:12 Sports Summer Internship June 13, 2027 - August 1, 2027 (7 Weeks) Intern Areas: Programs/Mentoring Administrative Media Company Overview Through Christ & community, 10:12 Sports uses athletics to provide mentoring and job training opportunities to youth. 10:12 empowers our community church partners and leaders to mentor youth through Christ, developing servant leaders and successful decision makers who commit to healthy lifestyles. We are currently in the process of building and strengthening a team that embraces that mindset & provides a transformational experience in urban ministry for our staff/interns. 10:12 Sports Core Values Christ – We believe that Christ came so that all may have an abundant life, so we strive to empower youth to reach their God-given potential with the skills they have been given. Community - We believe that it takes a strong community to raise a child and are intentional about partnering with local churches, organizations and community leaders to positively enhance the lives of our young men. Coaching – Sports provide a platform for coachable moments that can be applied both on and off the field. Through our leagues we emphasize the importance of integrity and servant leadership. Job Description In partnership with the Program Manager and Executive Director, the Summer Intern is responsible for utilizing their gifts to assist in ensuring a high-quality mentoring and Summer program leading to: participant development, retention, engagement, as well as increased organizational capacity. While there is a focus on Summer program operations this role entails a heavy emphasis on discipleship and the ability to flourish in relationship building, embodying many aspects of urban missions. The Intern will be joining a small but mighty team, and therefore (as indicated below) is expected to step into a diverse set of responsibilities. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Program Support (60%) Programs/Mentoring Intern • Assisting in successfully operating our Summer Programs: Football Mentoring Program, League Night, Game Day Jobs, Summer Leadership Academy, Equip 2 Serve, Youth Sports Clinics, Mentor Dinner. o Interns may assist in some of the following ways: ▪ Job Readiness support ▪ Mentoring teens ▪ Coaching Sports (teens and/or kids) ▪ Park/Neighborhood Beautification ▪ Cooking and/or Serving food/drinks/ lunch ▪ Planning & Leading lessons/activities/games ▪ Leading workouts ▪ Planning events ▪ Transporting participants ▪ Set-up/Cleanup ▪ Conducting Surveys/Registrations, Admin etc…. • Actively mentoring participants and encouraging a culture of servant leadership Administrative Intern • Assisting in successfully strengthening 10:12 Sports administrative and programmatic operations o Interns may assist in some of the following ways: ▪ Researching and recruiting for in-kind donations Assisting in administratively based tasks for sports mentoring programs ▪ Event Management ▪ Job Training Supports ▪ Data Entry ▪ Partner cultivation ▪ Transporting youth/interns ▪ Document creation ▪ Website content creation ▪ Improving Metrics Media Intern • Assisting in improving program media and marketing content o Interns may assist in some of the following ways: ▪ Content Creation (Social, website, flyers etc….) ▪ Media for campaigns, program highlights, promo videos etc… ▪ Assisting with updating and implementing marketing plan Ongoing Education (30%) • Engaging in learning about/participating in “Community Living” • Participating in ongoing education related to urban ministry (workshops, site visits, literature..) Marketing and Fundraising (10%) • Assisting in the marketing of 10:12 Sports programs and events QUALIFICATIONS AND PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS • Person of integrity, actively walking out their Christian faith • Passion for mentorship and servant leadership • Interest in youth development (program intern) • Ability to clearly communicate and effectively listen to youth, volunteers and staff • Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments • Conflict management and resolution skills • Alignment with 10:12 Sports’ mission and core values • Willingness to be a positive/active part of 10:12 house community • Interest in learning about God’s heart for the City and issues in it • High School Diploma Required Timeline and Compensation The Summer Intern is a full-time, seasonal position. 10:12 Sports is accepting LIMITED applications with a deadline of March 1, 2027 (7 weeks). 10:12 Sports is an organization that is adaptive to the needs of its students and community. Due to this, the Summer intern will not be working a typical schedule. HOUSING & FOOD WILL BE PROVIDED FOR THIS INTERNSHIP ALONG WITH A STIPEND Interested Candidates should fill out the “Intern” application on the 10:12 Sports Website

jobs.description: Employer: Van Metre Companies Expires: 11/20/2026 At Van Metre, we believe that each employee contributes directly to our growth, success and culture. We seek out candidates who love to challenge themselves and work with others to fulfill this role. Van Metre is seeking Property Management Interns for Summer 2027!This is a fully in-person internship with the schedule being Monday-Friday 9am to 6pm. On occasion there will be weekend work, but the working hours will not exceed 40 hours per week.Under the direction of the Director of Training and Development, the Interns will obtain knowledge helpful to generating traffic at residential properties, promoting resident retention, assistance with resident event planning, and providing exceptional customer service at all times. In addition, the Interns will also work with our Commercial Property Department, gaining exposure to this exciting field.All Van Metre interns will have the opportunity to meet and network with interns and employees from other departments and divisions. Interns will engage in a series of trainings that will help them to excel in their particular roles and to broaden their understanding of the company and the many different ways to become involved at Van Metre. jobs.title: Store Optimization - MBA Internship - Summer 2027 at Lowe's Companies, Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: Lowe's Companies, Inc. Expires: 11/20/2026 Your ImpactAs a Store Optimization Intern at Lowe’s, you’ll work with a team dedicated to enhancing store layouts, operations, and merchandising strategies to ensure a seamless and productive customer experience. You’ll gain hands-on experience in data analysis, project coordination, and cross-functional collaboration as you help drive improvements in store formats, adjacencies, and operational flow. Your work will support key business decisions that impact customer satisfaction, associate productivity, and overall store performance across 1,700+ retail locations. This role is ideal for those passionate about combining analytics with creativity to solve real-world retail challenges. Summer Internship ProgramWhether you’re starting your professional journey or pivoting to a new field, Lowe’s offers the resources and opportunities you need to thrive. Our 10-week summer internship program (May 24 – July 30, 2027) immerses you in real-world retail operations. You’ll work directly with industry experts across our stores, distribution centers, and corporate offices, gaining practical experience through hands-on projects that make meaningful contributions to our business and communities. To succeed in this role, we seek future leaders who:Drive innovation with fresh perspectives and an eagerness to learn.Bring dynamic energy while staying open to inspiration.Take on challenges with sharp thinking and embrace new opportunities.Build strong partnerships through collaborative teamwork.Push boundaries to discover what’s possible. Do Your Best Work in MooresvilleThis internship is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration. What You Will LearnHow store layouts and merchandise adjacencies influence customer experience and operational efficiency.Data-driven approaches to store planning, including analysis of traffic patterns, conversion metrics, and category performance.Tools used in store design and optimization (e.g., planogramming and CAD software).Collaboration with key stakeholders in Merchandising, Space Planning, and Operations.How to present findings and recommendations through compelling storytelling and visualization.Techniques for balancing business needs with customer expectations in store environments. Minimum QualificationsPursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Analytics, Retail Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.Expected graduation dates of December 2027 or May 2028. Preferred Skills/Experience3.0 cumulative GPA or higher.Proficient in MS Office Programs (specifically Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).Experience in retail, project planning, or operational analysis (academic or professional).Familiarity with retail design tools or analytics platforms (e.g., AutoCAD, Tableau, Power BI).Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.Passion for optimizing the in-store experience for both customers and associates. BenefitsPaid InternshipEligibility for Lowe’s Housing Benefit10% Associate Discount For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits. About Lowe’sLowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com. EEO StatementLowe’s is an equal opportunity employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, age, ancestry, national origin, mental or physical disability or medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Property Management Intern at JLL
jobs.description: Employer: JLL Expires: 11/20/2026 About Property Management:JLL's Property Management is a comprehensive service that focuses on managing and optimizing the performance of real estate properties on behalf of owners or investors. JLL acts as a trusted advisor, helping clients maximize the value of their assets while providing exceptional tenant experiences. Through their expertise in lease administration, financial management, and maintenance coordination, JLL property managers ensure that properties are efficiently operated and deliver strong returns for their clients. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights, JLL enables seamless communication, streamlined operations, and informed decision-making. The property management business line at JLL presents an exciting opportunity for college students to gain valuable experience, develop diverse skills, and contribute to the success of real estate portfolios.What the job involves:We are currently seeking an Intern in Property Management join our team. In this role, you will learn the basics of property management, invoicing/payment systems, and tenant experience/support.As an Intern in Property Management at JLL, you will learn the following:Process and code all accounts payable invoices at the property per established schedules.Ensure invoices are paid on time and review all past due invoices to ensure proper payment has been made. Research and request appropriate back-up from vendor if necessary.Send out rent statements to tenants in sufficient time according to accounting calendar.Collect rent and ensure accounts receivable balances are minimized at the property.Provide lease administration services to the property to include but not limited to lease abstraction and lease file maintenance.Track and maintain Certificates of Insurance; responsible for notifying tenants and vendors of expired COI's and COI requirements via letters.Maintain spreadsheet of COI's on file that detail the insured and the policy expiration.Generating contracts for services at the property per the direction and input of the General Manager.Complete assigned financial reporting tasks in support of client requirements.Assist the General Manager in preparation of the annual asset plan and budget.Provide quality assurance on contracted vendors as requested by the General Manager.Participate in the property’s Team Emergency Response Plan and procedures.Assist in Move-In/Move-Out processes and procedures.Answer telephones and greeting visitors.Administer tenant relations programs, including tenant events.Handle any tenant issues regarding maintenance or service requests quickly, passing along urgent matter to General Manager, when appropriate.Other duties as assigned by the General Manager falling within the reasonable expectations of an administrative position at a real estate services office.Program DetailsDates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027Location: Orlando, FL Education, Skills, and ExperienceActively pursuing a bachelor’s degree, with 2-3 years completed majoring in business or related field.Interest in property managementDemonstrated ability to take initiativeComfortable with public speakingAbility to develop relationshipsAbility to problem solve and bring innovative ideas to a challengeAble to work independently, with minimal directionAbility to work well within a team environmentWe do not offer relocation assistance or housing for our internship program.Permanent US work authorization required.About our Internship ProgramTake the opportunity to start your career early in the commercial real estate field! Spend time learning what it’s like to work in the fast-paced, entrepreneurial, team-oriented environment at JLL.Interns are an important part of what makes JLL a great place to work. Within our program, interns are an integral part of our team working alongside real estate analysts, transaction professionals and other associates. You will gain valuable insight into the commercial real estate industry while being exposed to multiple lines of business over the course of your internship.

jobs.title: Junior Events Coordinator / Intern at Le Basque Catering
jobs.description: Employer: Le Basque Catering Expires: 11/21/2026 About Us: Established in the 1990s, our luxury catering and production company has been the benchmark for high-end events, flawless hospitality, and bespoke design. From intimate, high-profile private dinners to grand corporate galas and multi-day productions, we handle events of all kinds and sizes with a signature commitment to refined elegance and European-rooted service standards. We pride ourselves on cultivating the next generation of hospitality leaders, providing hands-on mentorship in a fast-paced, luxury creative environment. Position Overview • Role: Junior Events Coordinator / Intern • Type: Hourly Internship / Part-time Contract • Duration: Approx. 3–4 months (Spanning our peak busy season, starting in November 2026). There is the potential to be hired full-time or have an internship extension.• Compensation: $15.00 / hour • Location: Miami, FL (Office prep and varying on-site event venues) • Target Audience: Passionate undergraduate students currently enrolled in a School of Hospitality & Tourism Management (or related program) seeking real-world luxury experience. Job Summary As a Junior Events Coordinator / Intern, you will work directly alongside our experienced Coordinators and Senior Producers during our most exciting and busiest time of the year. This role bridges the gap between the classroom and the elite event industry, offering a 360-degree view of what it takes to execute flawless luxury productions. You will assist with meticulous pre-event planning in the office and provide vital operational support on-site during live events. Core Responsibilities Pre-Event Preparation & Office Support: • Assist senior coordinators with event logistics, vendor sourcing, and organizing production timelines. • Help maintain and organize event inventory, design elements, and styling materials. • Review event orders, floor plans, and production notes to ensure total accuracy ahead of load-in. • Provide general administrative support to ensure the coordination team is fully equipped for upcoming events. On-Site Event Execution: • Assist with on-site setup, including managing timelines, spatial layout oversight, and meticulous aesthetic detailing. • Act as a reliable point of contact for coordinators, vendors, and service staff during live execution. • Help manage guest flow, registration, or specific activation zones depending on the scale of the event. • Assist with post-event strike and breakdown, ensuring all company assets are safely accounted for. Qualifications & Requirements We are looking for passionate, high-energy individuals who are eager to learn the art of old-school luxury hospitality. • Education: Currently pursuing an undergraduate or master's degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, or a related field. • The Luxury Mindset: An innate eye for detail, a polished professional presentation, and a deep appreciation for high-end aesthetics and formal service standards. • Adaptability & Stamina: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Events require long hours on your feet, moving quickly, and adapting to real-time changes. • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact professionally with high-net-worth clients, vendors, and internal teams. • Schedule Flexibility: Must be available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, aligned with our peak winter event calendar. • Transportation: Reliable transportation to get to our main office and various luxury event venues across the greater Miami area. What You Will Gain • Direct, resume-building experience with a pioneer in Miami’s luxury event industry. • Mentorship from seasoned industry professionals who understand the nuances of high-end catering and production. • Networking opportunities within the elite tiers of South Florida’s hospitality scene. • Flexible hourly scheduling that can work around your final exams and winter course load. To Apply: Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter detailing your career goals in luxury hospitality and your availability for the winter season. Immediate positions are open for our upcoming peak period!

jobs.description: Employer: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Expires: 11/21/2026 As an employee of the Atlanta Fed, you will help support our mission of promoting the stability and efficiency of the U.S. economy and financial system. Your work will affect the economy of the Southeast, the United States, and the world. The work we do here is important, and how we do it is just as important as what we do. We live our values of integrity, excellence, and respect every day. We do the right thing, we do things right, and we treat people right. A career at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta gives you the chance to do work that touches lives and helps communities prosper. The Bank believes in flexibility to balance the demands of work and life while also recognizing the necessity of connecting and collaborating with our colleagues in person. Onsite work is an essential function of this position, and you are required to be onsite according to the schedule set by your management. OUR BANK - The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States and is one of the most influential, trusted, and prestigious financial organizations. It consists of twelve Reserve Banks located around the country and the Board of Governors in Washington, D.C. The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta territory covers the Sixth Federal Reserve District, which includes Alabama, Florida, and Georgia, and portions of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee. The Atlanta Fed and the other Reserve Banks play an important part in all three of the Fed's functions: monetary policy, bank supervision and regulation, and the operation of a nationwide payment system. PLEASE READ: Internships are paid. Summer housing will not be provided. This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, performance standards or requirements, efforts, skills or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g. emergencies, rush jobs, change in workload or technological developments). SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT: This role will support the local Information Security function in delivering District-specific security services that complement centralized enterprise security programs. This role provides exposure to the unique responsibilities of District-level security work, including local incident coordination, threat monitoring, risk assurance, and stakeholder engagement — all performed in close partnership with central security teams while addressing needs specific to this Reserve Bank location. QUALIFICATIONS: Networking Knowledge: Understand TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and firewalls to see how data moves and where vulnerabilities hide.Operating Systems: Know your way around both Windows and Linux command lines, file structures, and user permissions.Security Principles: Grasp core ideas like the CIA triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability), threat analysis, and basic risk management.Basic Scripting: Write simple scripts in Python or PowerShell to automate tasks and analyze data quickly. PREFERRED MAJORS: Computer ScienceCybersecurityRisk ManagementComputer Information Systems CORE COMPETENCIES: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) Strong analytical skills Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects Great work ethic and detail oriented Comfortable working across time zones to complete projects in a timely manner OUR BENEFITS TO INTERNS (some benefits are subject to being onsite): Professional development opportunities Networking MARTA passes provided Free LinkedIn Learning access Free access to our FedFuel career development tool Café and dining options on-site Dress for your day Flexible hours Access to on-site fitness center TO APPLY: In addition to your application, please attach a resume and a copy of your most recent unofficial transcript. Additional Requirements: This position will require at minimum fingerprinting for a criminal background check, education and employment verification, along with potential additional screening requirements due to the information accessed while performing the job. Any offer of employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of any required background screening. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Summer Analyst Internship Program SummaryThe Summer Analyst Internship Program offers students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in investment banking within a high-profile department at Crédit Agricole CIB. jobs.title: 2027 Investor Operations Summer Internship at Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH)
jobs.description: Employer: Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) Expires: 11/21/2026 2027 Investor Operations InternshipNew Jersey At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership - it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career. We’re looking for sharp minds and bold thinkers to join our internship program - your pathway to real-world operations, transformation, and technology that drive global banking, and the kind of professional development that sets you apart. We value our internship programs as they help us identify our future hires and leaders. What You’ll Experience in BBH’s Internship Program:Overview: Experience a dynamic 10-week internship where you will be fully immersed in BBH’s culture and business needs.Hands-On Learning: Dive into meaningful projects supporting Investor Services Service Delivery division across operations and global client service.Mentorship That Matters: Work side by side with industry leaders who are invested in your growth.Professional Development: Sharpen your skills through workshops, speaker series, and networking events designed to accelerate your career. Receive continuous and personalized feedback throughout the program, empowering you to grow, refine your skills, and navigate your path to success.Collaborative Environment: Join a tight-knit team where your ideas are heard, your contributions matter, and your potential is unleashed.On-Site Presence: Immerse yourself in our company culture and accelerate your professional development with daily in-office presence.Community: Make a positive impact by volunteering in our philanthropic program, BBHcares, while connecting with fellow BBHers. Ever wonder what happens behind the scenes as a financial transaction moves around the world? BBH Service Delivery is the operational engine behind the banking. An internship within Service Delivery provides a unique perspective on how BBH delivers service excellence to our global clients and across the organization. If you’re passionate about learning the different areas of the banking business, leading transformation, leveraging data and technology, and driving business outcomes for a global organization, Service Delivery is the place for you. What you can expect from a BBH Service Delivery Internship:Join a dynamic team at the heart of global operations, partnering with business leaders to deliver insights and information to support internal stakeholders and clients.Gain hands-on experience managing high-volume financial transactions with accuracy, efficiency, and a strong commitment to meeting critical deadlines.Put your analytical and problem-solving skills to work by investigating discrepancies, identifying root causes, and escalating findings when appropriate.Build relationships across the business by communicating clearly and confidently with internal and external clients and counterparties to resolve issues and help minimize riskLearn what exceptional client service looks like in practice and contribute to the high-quality experience BBH delivers to clients around the world.Take on specialized projects where you will work with large data sets, uncover meaningful insights, and help inform operational decisions.Exposure to leading edge financial services technology including Generative AI tools.Share ideas to improve operational efficiency and individual productivity, contribute to department and BBH process improvement activities.Collaborate with fellow interns on a high-visibility team project and present your recommendations to senior leaders. Areas of focus may include:Fund Accounting – processing activities within funds, compiling reporting, assisting with NAV process, Alternatives / Private Markets operationsCustody Operations – processing client instructions, document validation, verifying and validating transactions, participating in client callsGlobal Client Service – Participating in client meetings, handling inquiries, compiling reportingTransformation Management – automating processes for operational teams, compiling data, assisting with project-based documents What Service Delivery Operations looks for in an Intern:Current junior in college, entering senior year in Fall 2027, with a background in and passion for Business, Innovation and Design, or Project Management. Strong academic achievement as evidenced by a GPA of 3.3 or higher. Demonstrated leadership skills through academic and extracurricular activities. Outstanding communication skills, written and verbal; ability to explain technical issues in simple terms. Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically, both independently and as part of a team. Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to identify, escalate, and resolve problems. Ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple deadlines. Ability to analyze business processes to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement. Experience or interest in working with large quantities of information for analysis. Intermediate proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint - comfortable using common formulas (e.g., VLOOKUP, IF), building basic charts, and creating/manipulating pivot tables for simple analysis. Passion and intellectual curiosity for learning, and the use of generative AI tools. Ready to Apply? Applications for BBH’s 2027 Internship Program close October 28th, 2026. Don’t miss your chance to work alongside industry leaders, gain hands-on experience, and immerse yourself in a culture of excellence. Apply early to secure your spot and start building your future with BBH. Candidates should submit applications for a maximum of two positions. Applications should be targeted to the roles that most closely align with the candidate's background and interests. We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, included alternative experiences, or if it doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.About BBH:Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us. We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development - so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice - creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another. We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often - pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours. Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, genetic information, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Summer Analyst - Energy and Real Assets - Latin America at Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
jobs.description: Employer: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank Expires: 11/21/2026 ABOUT CRÉDIT AGRICOLE CIBCrédit Agricole CIB is the Corporate and Investment Banking arm of the Crédit Agricole Group, the 10th largest banking group worldwide by balance sheet size (The Banker, 2022). The Bank offers clients a broad range of products and services across capital markets, investment banking, structured finance, and corporate banking.As the No. 1 retail bank in France, Crédit Agricole is the leading financial partner of the French economy and one of the largest retail banks in Europe — committed to building a world-class European leader in banking and insurance in accordance with the UN Global Compact. US Analyst Internship Program SummaryThe Summer Analyst Internship Program offers students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in investment banking within a high-profile department at Crédit Agricole CIB. Interns work alongside experienced professionals, receiving mentorship and real-world exposure to deal origination, portfolio management, and credit analysis. Top performers have the opportunity to convert into full-time US Analyst roles following graduation. Divisional OverviewCrédit Agricole CIB's Energy & Infrastructure Group (EIG) Latin America team sources and manages complex project financings across the Latin American energy and infrastructure sectors. Based in New York, the team focuses on originating new business while managing an active portfolio of existing loans. The Intern will support senior team members in pitching for business, processing credit applications, closing financings, and managing portfolio transactions in coordination with the Portfolio Manager. RESPONSIBILITIES• Support the Group's efforts in managing the portfolio of existing project finance loans to energy and infrastructure projects across Latin America, including performing annual reviews and preparing material for approval of waivers and amendments • Assist the Group Head and Portfolio Manager on periodic reporting to Head Office • Support monitoring of Know-Your-Customer reviews of clients in the portfolio • Build and review financial models based on contract terms and economic assumptions under senior guidance • Develop and improve skills in financial modeling through hands-on assignments • Assist in preparing proposals to clients, identifying project specifics, indicative terms, CACIB credentials, and team organization • Participate in preparation and execution of pitches to clients in coordination with relationship managers • Support preparation of business opportunity memoranda and credit applications, including transaction descriptions, key features, and risk analysis • Complete internal worksheets and applications (rating grid, environmental screening, profitability calculation, KYC forms, and compliance items) MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS • Currently enrolled student or recent graduate expected to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028 • Must be eligible to work in the US without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future (including but not limited to F-1, OPT, CPT, H-1B, or any other visa category) • 0–1 years of professional experience in Finance or a related field PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Degree in Finance, Economics, or related field • Prior experience building and reviewing financial models • Familiarity with energy and infrastructure projects • Excellent written and oral communication skills • Proficiency in Spanish • Prior internship or banking experience

jobs.title: Financial Advisor Intern at Baystate Financial
jobs.description: Employer: Baystate Financial Expires: 11/21/2026 BEGIN YOUR FINANCIAL CAREER WITH AN INTERNSHIP WITH BAYSTATE FINANCIAL **We are currently interviewing for our Summer 2027 internship class in all of our New England offices** The first step in our interview process is to join a group information session via Zoom to learn more about Baystate Financial, the career of an advisor, and the industry in general. Our next information session is scheduled for Thursday November 19th at 11am . Please use the following link to register:https://financialguide.zoom.us/meeting/register/13bbpaTVTdaqteUivYdCFQ In addition, please complete the Culture Index Survey listed below:https://go.cultureindex.com/p/3Cs6YkulwTG1 Baystate Financial is selecting full-time college students for our hands-on internship program. We are seeking highly motivated, entrepreneurial students, interested in a career in finance. Selected candidates will be given the opportunity to get fully licensed as a financial advisor, receive top-notch training and mentorship, and gain valuable professional experience transferable to any industry. Interns that prove to be an asset to the firm will be offered a full-time position upon graduating. About This Internship Right from the beginning students are given the resources needed to help clients achieve financial security. Financial Advisor Interns are taught how to build a financial services practice from the ground up. With the help of senior advisors and the Baystate team, students will meet with clients to learn more about their individual definition of financial security and develop a “financial roadmap” to get them from where they are currently, to where they want to be. At the end of the internship, successful interns will be able to exhibit: An Understanding of How to Create and Implement a Personal Financial Plan Client Acquisition and Marketing Strategies The Role of a Full Time Financial Advisor Exceptional Listening and Problem-Solving Skills The Ability to Work Well in Both a Team and Individual Capacity Candidate Characteristics Although there are a wide variety of college majors, personal backgrounds, and life experiences that will see success in this role, there are a few characteristics we see exhibited in the majority of our most successful interns: Strong Desire to Help People, Including Individuals, Families, and Small Businesses Motivated to Work in a Client Facing/ Sales/ Finance Role Competitive, with an Entrepreneurial Spirit and a Vision to Build and Grow Their Own Business High Standards or Integrity, Empathy, Competency, Work Ethic, and Professionalism “Interested individuals are invited to apply. And, while we appreciate every applicant's interest, only those under consideration will be contacted.” About Baystate Financial Since its founding in 1901, Baystate Financial has provided comprehensive financial services, life and disability insurance, estate planning, business succession planning, retirement funding, education funding strategies, and investment management to a diverse client base. More than a century of providing guidance, insight, and results has made Baystate Financial one of the oldest and largest wealth management firms in the northeast, with 12 offices in 6 New England States. Baystate Financial is comprised of a team of over 300 advisors and over 400 support staff, many of whom contribute to building financial plans for a wide variety of individuals and businesses. Baystate Financials’ strategy is tailored to help fulfill their client’s individual goals, with the understanding that every client’s goals are different.

jobs.description: Employer: New York Life Insurance Company Expires: 11/21/2026 Shape your future with a dynamic internship experience at New York Life. We offer opportunities across a variety of exciting businesses, including Actuarial, AI & Data, Finance, Investments, Technology, Underwriting, and more. Your internship journey is designed to challenge you through hands-on work experience that will equip you with valuable skills you can use anywhere. You will build your network through collaboration and connection with talented interns and experienced employees through team-building activities, mentorship programs, and fun social events. By the end of your internship, you'll be equipped with new skills and a network that will propel you forward in your career journey. Role OverviewNew York Life Group Benefit Solutions (NYL GBS) is seeking a Sales Summer Intern to join a dynamic 10-week internship program designed to provide hands-on exposure to Sales and Account Management. In this role, you will work alongside experienced Sales Representatives and Account Executives to support business development efforts, strengthen client and broker relationships, and contribute to the success of a local sales office. The internship offers opportunities to learn about the employee benefits industry, develop business acumen, and gain practical experience across multiple functions that support the sales process. What You'll DoGain hands-on experience supporting Field Sales and Account Management teams while learning how broker and client relationships are developed and maintained.Learn the NYL GBS product portfolio and collaborate with cross-functional partners across Sales, Account Management, Underwriting, Marketing, and Operations to understand how business objectives are achieved.Utilize business platforms and technology tools including Salesforce, BenefitFlow, Tableau, and generative AI solutions to organize information, analyze data, and support sales activities.Participate in mentorship, networking, and professional development opportunities with sales leaders, account executives, and other business professionals to enhance industry knowledge and career readiness.Collaborate with fellow interns on a capstone project focused on problem-solving, innovation, and teamwork while presenting recommendations and insights to stakeholders. Required SkillsRising senior pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field.Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to learn and apply new concepts.Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word, and the ability to organize and present information clearly.Interest in client-facing work and a willingness to contribute in a results-oriented, fast-paced business environment.Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Preferred SkillsCumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.Demonstrated interest in Sales, Account Management, Employee Benefits, or related business functions.Goal-oriented mindset with a passion for delivering value and solving business challenges.Strong interpersonal and networking skills with the confidence to engage with professionals across various levels of the organization. To be eligible for this program, you must be authorized to work in the U.S. We do not offer any type of employment-based immigration sponsorship for this program. Likewise, this program is not available to those authorized to work under optional practical training (OPT) or curricular practical training (CPT). Curious what it’s like to intern at NYL? jobs.title: Marketing Intern — Social Media & TikTok Content at Vitablabla
jobs.description: Employer: Vitablabla Expires: 11/21/2026 Job title: Marketing Intern — Social Media & TikTok Content Job type: Internship (part-time) Work setting: Remote (U.S. only) Compensation: $20/hour + 5% commission on sales generated by your videos — 1099 independent contractor. The role begins with a paid working interview: 8 videos × $30 ($240 total stipend with free sample). Hours: ~10–25 hrs/week, flexible around class schedules About UsOHCRISP is a growing U.S. snack brand making seriously crunchy freeze-dried fruit snacks. We're looking for a marketing intern who wants real, hands-on social media experience — not coffee runs and shadowing calls. You'll create TikTok content for a real consumer brand, see exactly how your videos perform, and learn how creator-led commerce (TikTok Shop) works from the inside. Our interview process — two steps, no busywork Step 1: A 30-minute video chat. A quick hello — we get a feel for your personality and on-camera presence, and you can ask us anything. No trick questions, no case studies. Step 2: A paid working trial. Film 8 videos for us over ~2 weeks and get paid $30 for each video you submit ($240 total, paid after each submission via Venmo/Zelle). You show us what you can do, we pay you for it — and if it's a fit, you continue as our marketing intern. Free product provided, obviously. What you'll do as an intern Create TikTok videos featuring OHCRISP: taste tests, snack reviews, trending formats, dorm-life content, ASMR crunch videos Brainstorm hooks, formats, and content series with our team Track what's working and help shape our content strategy. Who this is for Currently enrolled U.S. college student, 18+ Native English speaker, comfortable appearing on camera and speaking in videos You already make TikToks — or have always wanted an excuse to start Interested in marketing, social media, content, or consumer brands as a career pathNo followers, no formal experience required Happy to complete paperwork if your school offers internship credit Submitted videos must meet a basic content checklist (shared upfront). By submitting content, you grant OHCRISP the right to use approved videos on our brand channels, website, and paid ads How to applyUpload your resume and link 2–3 videos you've made (personal TikToks/Instagram are fine). We review applications on a rolling basis.

The intern will leverage market research, Voice of Customer (VOC) insights, competitive analysis, and go-to-market strategy to address a real business challenge. The experience culminates in the development and presentation of a strategic recommendation to Graco’s Executive Leadership Team. This internship is designed for MBA candidates seeking a long-term career in category marketing, product marketing, strategic marketing, or general management. Program Structure: This summer internship is centered on a high-value strategic project that addresses a real business opportunity or challenge within an assigned category and which has the potential to shape future growth initiatives. The project is supplemented by exposure to the broader category marketing function and close collaboration with cross-functional partners, including product management, channel marketing, corporate marketing, and sales. The internship culminates in a strategic recommendation presented to senior internship. Work closely with a Category Marketing leader to define the project scope, conduct analysis, and develop recommendations. Apply market research, customer insights, and business strategy concepts to address a meaningful business question. Develop and present a final recommendation to senior leaders at the conclusion of the internship. Market and Customer Insights Conduct market, customer, and competitive research to better understand industry trends and customer needs. Analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback and other data sources to identify key insights and opportunities. Learn how customer and market insights are used to shape busness and marketing strategies. Coordinate with internal subject matter experts to validate research findings and assumptions. Professional Development Build skills in strategic thinking, business analysis, executive communication, and problem solving. jobs.description: Employer: Tualatin Hills Park & Recreation District Expires: 11/21/2026 Diversify Internship - Applicants Must Apply Directly to THPRD'S Jobs PageTualatin Hills Park & Recreation District (THPRD) is firmly committed to fostering an inclusive environment that is representative of the community we serve through embracing employees from varied backgrounds, identities, and lived experiences. The Diversify Internship Program aims to magnify the lens of those whose journey has been impacted by race/ethnicity, LGBTQ+ identities, experiences with a disability, and other identities.We take pride in offering internship opportunities that explore a wide range of career possibilities within the field of parks and recreation. Our goal is to create an inclusive learning, working, and networking environment for all interns.For the Winter 2027 cohort, which will take place from January 11 – March 19, we’re excited to provide the following 6 internship opportunities:Digital Innovation Intern – Garden Home Recreation Center is seeking an intern who will support the development and implementation of a digital system designed to streamline the afterschool program’s records, logs, and communications. This role will adapt the Microsoft Forms Communications Log system currently used by other THPRD centers for use in Garden Home’s afterschool and camp programs. The final project may include proposing a foundational process that other centers can further tailor to meet the needs of their individual programs. Ideal for those pursuing degrees or who have an interest in Education, Recreational Programs, Communication, Computer and Information Sciences, or Youth Development. Proposed Schedule: M-F, 1:30-6:30pm Event Operations Intern– This intern will gain valuable hands-on experience in the event planning and management industry. This role will involve assisting with various aspects of event setup, hosting, and administrative tasks. This internship is designed to provide equal opportunities for students interested in parks and recreation careers, with a focus on fostering an environment that is inclusive and representative of the communities we serve. Proposed Schedule: During regular weeks, standard hours are Tuesdays and Wednesdays from 8:00 AM to 4:45pm. On event weeks, this position will work the scheduled event instead of their regular Tuesday and Wednesday hours, working directly alongside a full-time team member. Events may occur Monday through Sunday between 8:00 AM and 8:00pm. Nature Center Marketing Intern – This intern will help share the Nature Center’s story through updated webpage content, short videos, and social media. They will also research marketing strategies to increase awareness and participation in our programs, helping connect more people to nature. Ideal for those interested in marketing, digital storytelling, and community engagement. Proposed Schedule: M-F, 8:00a-4:00pm with option to add Saturdays Sports Policy Intern – This intern will be assigned to our Tennis Center on the Howard M. Terpenning Recreation Complex. This intern's primary duties will focus on policy and best practice development for our new pickleball facility which we will be breaking ground next Fall 2027. In addition, they will be involved in program development for the new facility. Ideal for those pursuing degrees or have interest in Sports Leadership & Management, Tourism, Recreation and Adventure Leadership, Sports Communication, and Outdoor Leadership. Proposed Schedule: M-F, hours flexible Therapeutic Recreation Intern – This opportunity is for students pursuing a career in Recreation Therapy. The intern will work under the supervision of a Certified Therapeutic Recreation Specialist (CTRS) in a fast-paced community recreation setting, supporting patrons with a variety of physical, cognitive, social, and emotional disabilities. The intern will have the opportunity to lead TR groups, assist with camp for patrons with disabilities, organize staff and volunteers, and participate in special events. To be eligible for this internship, candidates must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Therapeutic Recreation or a related field and must have completed the required coursework necessary for the internship. Must have a state issued Driver's License, with the ability to travel independently between different centers throughout the district. Proposed Schedule: M/Th 12-9p; T/W/Fr 11a-7p, with potential for weekend special events (40hr for 14 weeks = 560 hours to meet TR certification requirements) THRIVE Intern– This intern will be assigned to THRIVE, a District-wide afterschool program which operates at four recreation centers in THPRD. This intern’s primary duties will focus on developing and improving systems for staff onboarding, training, and program resources. Projects may include creating a standardized Staff Onboarding Toolkit and a centralized Activity & Curriculum Resource Library that staff can utilize within the program. Ideal for those pursuing degrees or who have an interest in Education or Curriculum Development, Recreational Programs or Adventure Leadership, Sports Leadership & Management, Communication, or Youth Development. Proposed Schedule: M-F, 12:00-5:00pm with room for flexibilityThe district also provides a bilingual pay incentive to paid interns who regularly use their bilingual or multilingual skills! Click here to learn more and view the full job description.These internships are budgeted for 10 weeks and up to 20 hours per week or 200 hours total over the course of the internship.The district will work with interns to develop a schedule that works around their current class schedule. Hours will vary depending on the program’s needs and may include weekend days and evenings. Part-time employees are scheduled variable hours and may work less than 1,560 hours per year.Typical job duties vary based on the program area and include both administrative and field experience interacting with patrons to:Perform a wide variety of work duties and responsibilities based on assignment, academic coursework, and/or degree program. Conduct research and analysis; prepares project reports, progress summaries, spreadsheets, and other written materials. Assist in the development and delivery of program materials and program area activities. Schedules and facilitates meetings with staff, (which may be indoors, outdoors and/or virtually) as needed to accomplish project goals. Perform data entry. Prepare and/or proofread a variety of forms, letters, flyers, promotional materials, etc. Research policies, procedures, guidelines, and standards; identifies opportunities for improvement and makes recommendations. Assist in promoting positive public relations and customer service for various programs, services, or activities. Attend and participate in staff meetings, trainings, and workshops. Participate in various phases of a planned training and evaluation of the internship program. Interns in this position will work with a supervisor to collaboratively identify steps to complete the project that fit both the intern’s goals and the district’s needs. Interns will also gain experience working with cross-district employees while contributing to a positive and inclusive experience for community members.Previous experience in the focus area is desired but not required. Successful candidates will have a basic understanding of software and computer operations, written and verbal communication, basic math, and an interest in parks and recreation.Application ReviewApplications are reviewed as they are received. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at hr@thprd.org. jobs.title: Simulation Engineer Intern at Wing
jobs.description: Employer: Wing Expires: 11/21/2026 About the Program: Join Wing's 12-week paid summer internship! This is a hybrid, in-person program based in Palo Alto, CA, with start dates in May or June. Eligible candidates must be a current student enrolled in a degree program and intend to return to the program after the completion of the summer internship. About the Role:Wing is looking for a Simulation Engineer Intern to join our Simulation & Evaluation Team based in Palo Alto, CA. Our team develops tools that enable engineers to develop, test and deploy features efficiently and at scale. Our work spans vehicle physics and sensor modeling, large-scale simulation frameworks, test infrastructure for backend verification, integrated avionics and system testing, and foundational ML technologies such as world-modelling, 3D reconstruction and sim2real. Our team is dedicated to ensuring simulation is the fastest and most reliable way to test changes to our system and to enable safer and faster feature development.The successful candidate is able to demonstrate adeptness at software development, system modeling and simulation, 3D geometry, and RL techniques. We are looking for individuals with strong written and verbal communication skills who thrive collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, spanning Simulation, Perception, and GNC, and who can tackle complex, open-ended engineering problems.In this role you will: Explore new and creative ways to use our wealth of real-world flight data to help validate our flight software.Build closed-loop simulation environments using real flight telemetry to enable counterfactual rollouts and policy evaluation for RL-based flight autonomyLeverage large-scale simulation and data pipelines to run critical experiments, draw actionable engineering insights, and contribute alongside a dedicated team committed to supporting your mentorship and growth.Make a measurable impact on Wing's ability to scale our operations more rapidly, at the forefront of the rapidly growing drone delivery industry.What You’ll Need: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related field, graduating between December 2027 and August 2028.Strong examples of previous engineering experience from past internships and/or academic or extracurricular projects.Strong grasp of dynamical systems, linear algebra, 3D geometry, and vision-based autonomy.Experience with C++ and/or Python.Experience with using some numerical or statistics library and environment (e.g. numpy, scipy, pandas, Matlab, R, etc.) to analyze real-world data (e.g. fitting models, simple ML approaches).Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts across disciplines.

jobs.description: Employer: Center on Budget and Policy Priorities Expires: 11/22/2026 The Center on Budget and Policy Priorities (CBPP) is a high-caliber strategic policy institute that informs and shapes public policies to reduce poverty, promote equity, and build opportunity. It has a national reputation for conducting rigorous research and analysis, developing evidence-based policy ideas and strategies, shaping a broad array of policy debates at the federal and state levels, and influencing policy outcomes on a range of critical issues. It focuses on improving the lives of people with low or moderate incomes and examines how policies affect particular groups, including Black, Indigenous, and other people of color; immigrants; people with disabilities; and LGBTQ+ people. CBPP is known for its unique capacity to blend rigorous, timely analysis with effective communications that enable policymakers and the media to make use of its work.The Health Policy team is actively involved in policy discussions related to the Affordable Care Act (ACA), Medicaid, the Children’s Health Insurance Program (CHIP), and other health care issues that affect low- and moderate-income families. The Health Policy Intern assists in all aspects of this process, including research, qualitative and quantitative analysis, data collection and management, and strategic problem solving, with the goal of understanding how various administrative policies and legislative proposals affect families and federal and state budgets.Qualifications:Demonstrated interest in health care policy and general familiarity with the ACA, Medicaid, and CHIP.Basic quantitative and analytic skills and the ability to synthesize large amounts of data.Experience translating policy into public products through writing or graphics work preferred. Understanding of and appreciation for CBPP’s mission and an interest in improving health care for low-income families and individuals.Basic familiarity with U.S. health insurance infrastructure. Education: current undergraduate students, graduate/PhD students, or recent graduates. Coursework in health care policy, social statistics, or research methods.Successful interns will have a commitment to CBPP’s mission to improve the well-being of low- and moderate-income people and advance racial equity.To expand the diversity of voices that speak with authority in federal and state policy debates, CBPP’s internship program identifies highly motivated candidates — particularly those with experience with communities that are underrepresented in policy debates — with a demonstrated interest in working on public policies that affect low-income and diverse communities and have implications for racial equity.International students are welcome to apply. CBPP does not provide financial sponsorship for visas or work permits. You must have documentation of work authorization for the U.S. AND a U.S. Social Security number, as of the start date of the internship, to be employed by CBPP.Application Deadline: November 22nd, 2026, 11:59 p.m. ETInternship Start Date: January 12, 2027Internship End Date: May 7, 2027CBPP's Spring internship will be remote. Remote interns must be in the U.S. for the duration of the internship. Interns located in the Washington, D.C. metro area during the Spring term will work on a hybrid schedule that includes at least two days per week in person at our D.C. office.Work Hours: Interns should be available between 30-40 hours per week during core Eastern Time business hours. Work schedules can be flexed to accommodate time zone differences as well as classwork and other school commitments.Compensation:Undergraduate students receive $18.40 per hour. Students with a bachelor's degree receive $19.00 per hour. Graduate students receive $20.00 per hour. Students with a master’s or law degree receive $21.00 per hour. Doctoral students may receive between $20.00 and $22.00 per hour, depending on progress toward completion of degree requirements, relevant coursework, and research. Required application materials:Cover letter (please include a discussion of what draws you to CBPP’s mission and the Health Policy team’s work) Résumé Transcript(s) Only complete applications submitted electronically through our system will be considered. Scrub Club Denver is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented intern to help keep our vacation rentals guest-ready while learning how a growing cleaning company operates.You’ll work directly with our founder and operations team, gain experience in property inspections, and help improve our quality-control process.**What You’ll Do**- Complete **12 property inspections per week**, scheduled as cleaners finish and before guests arrive.- Check bathrooms, kitchens, bedding, floors, staging, and supplies using our inspection checklist.- Upload photos and inspection notes through Breezeway.- Communicate touch-up needs promptly and help verify corrections.- Track recurring issues and suggest ways to improve consistency.**What You’ll Learn**- Vacation rental hospitality and guest-readiness standards.- Quality assurance, reporting, and professional team communication.- Scheduling and coordination using Breezeway.- Small-business operations through direct mentorship from our founder.You’ll receive paid training and shadowing, participate in weekly mentorship check-ins, and complete a practical project—such as improving our inspection checklist or creating a guide to common cleaning misses.**Schedule & Commitment**- Initial **12-week internship**.- Target of **12 property inspections each week**.- Daytime availability required, with some weekend availability preferred.- Inspection windows agreed upon around your class schedule and our cleaning bookings. jobs.title: MSFT AI Business Solutions Implementation Intern at Crowe Advisory LLC
jobs.description: Employer: Crowe Advisory LLC Expires: 11/22/2026 Job SummaryYour Journey at Crowe Starts Here:At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. Job Description:What It Means to Be a Consultant at CroweConsulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. As a MSFT AI Business Solutions Implementation Consultant team member in Crowe’s Consulting Practice, your role will be focused on helping clients resolve business needs to improve operating performance, use of technology, delivery of customer experiences and/or management decision making. You will define, craft, develop and implement business and technology solutions based on analysis of current practices, processes, technologies and data in comparison to leading industry practices, technologies and benchmarks. Projects in this role could include business process consulting/reengineering, organizational change management, project management support, technology assessments, financial analysis, municipal advisory, data analysis, and functional assistance implementing new technology systems that enable clients to improve the performance of their organizations. Typical project responsibilities could include process mapping, data and requirements gathering and analysis, client meeting facilitation support, preparing and supporting presentations, project management support, change management, business process analysis, strategic planning, and financial analysis. Projects in this role could also be structured around the finance and regulatory compliance needs of state and local governmental organizations in the areas of public finance (municipal advisory, budgeting & forecasting, financial management, arbitrage rebate liability calculations and verification services) or rate and feasibility studies. Your career could launch in one of the following areas: Manufacturing and DistributionYou will work with clients in the manufacturing industry to help transform their business requirements into a state-of-the-art technology solution that will enable their organization to exploit new opportunities, engage better with their customers and compete globally in the dynamic “Cloud-First” era. New hires will assist in software implementation through requirements gathering, configuration, testing, rollout and training. Our technology solutions help support business functions such as finance, operations, risk management and compliance. Public SectorYou will have the opportunity to work with clients in a wide variety of state and local government agencies to help solve problems. This includes helping them determine their needs or assisting them in defining, designing, developing and implementing solutions that provide critical value to their organization. At Crowe, we empower you to take risks, to challenge yourself in specialized areas of consulting & technology, and to generate solutions that impact the firm and your professional growth. Crowe cultivates a creative company culture where you will have the opportunity to share your ideas and knowledge with clients from your very first day with the firm. Skills and Requirements: Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to troubleshoot and identify root cause and resolve issues. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to effectively simplify and communicate complex concepts to stakeholders. Team Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively across skillsets and geographies. Strong interpersonal skills and team building Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously upskill Education:We’re looking for college junior students who are pursuing degrees in Industrial Engineering/Supply Chain, Public Policy/Public Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related field, and are eager to launch a career in a fast-paced, client-focused environment. Preferred areas of study include:Industrial Engineering or Systems EngineeringEconomics, Public Policy, or Public FinanceOperations Management or Supply ChainPublic & Environmental AffairsBusiness Administration, Accounting, or FinanceInformation Technology or Management Information SystemsInformation Science, Computing & InformaticsComputer Science with a focus on cybersecurity, networks, or security engineering We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $27.00 - $42.00 per hour. Our Benefits:Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!How You Can Grow:We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!More about Crowe:Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services. The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world.* As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide. *As of July 2026.Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws. Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban-the-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable. We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination. If you are interested in applying for employment with Crowe and are in need of an accommodation or require special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please visit our Applicant Assistance and Accommodations page for more information: https://careers.crowe.com/crowe-applicant-assistance-and-accommodation Job available in these locationsChicago, Illinois, United States of AmericaAtlanta, Georgia, United States of AmericaIndianapolis, Indiana, United States of AmericaNashville, Tennessee, United States of America
